<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_BuildingTreeHouse" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/building-a-tree-house">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_BuildingTreeHouse">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_You" name="You" processRef="Process_You"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Architect" name="Tree house architect"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_OnlineStores" name="Online stores"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RequirementsToArchitect" name="Requirements" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirements" targetRef="Participant_Architect"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DraftFromArchitect" name="Draft" sourceRef="Participant_Architect" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDraft"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OrderToStores" name="Material order" sourceRef="Task_OrderMaterials" targetRef="Participant_OnlineStores"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BuildRequestToFriends" name="Build request" sourceRef="Task_SendBuildRequests" targetRef="Participant_Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InvitationToFriends" name="Party invitation" sourceRef="Task_SendInvitations" targetRef="Participant_Friends"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_You" name="Building a tree house" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_BuildHouse" name="Want to build a tree house"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectRequirements" name="Collect requirements"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefineMerge" name="Requirements to send"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRequirements" name="Send requirements to architect"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveDraft" name="Receive draft from architect"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefineSplit" name="Refinement complete?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateMaterialsList" name="Create list of needed materials from plan"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_OrderSplit" name="Order and inform friends"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_OrderMaterials" name="Order materials from online stores by category"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_MaterialsOrdered" name="Materials ordered"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendBuildRequests" name="Send build requests to friends"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_HouseBuilt" name="House is built"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendInvitations" name="Send tree house party invitations to friends"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateAttendeeList" name="Create list of party attendees"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_AttendeeListCreated" name="Attendee list created"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Collect" sourceRef="StartEvent_BuildHouse" targetRef="Task_CollectRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Collect_Merge" sourceRef="Task_CollectRequirements" targetRef="Gateway_RefineMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_SendReq" sourceRef="Gateway_RefineMerge" targetRef="Task_SendRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendReq_ReceiveDraft" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirements" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveDraft_Split" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveDraft" targetRef="Gateway_RefineSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_AdditionalRequirements" name="No, additional requirements" sourceRef="Gateway_RefineSplit" targetRef="Gateway_RefineMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_CreateMaterials" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RefineSplit" targetRef="Task_CreateMaterialsList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CreateMaterials_OrderSplit" sourceRef="Task_CreateMaterialsList" targetRef="Gateway_OrderSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderSplit_OrderMaterials" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderSplit" targetRef="Task_OrderMaterials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderMaterials_End" sourceRef="Task_OrderMaterials" targetRef="EndEvent_MaterialsOrdered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderSplit_BuildRequests" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderSplit" targetRef="Task_SendBuildRequests"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BuildRequests_HouseBuilt" sourceRef="Task_SendBuildRequests" targetRef="Event_HouseBuilt"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HouseBuilt_Invitations" sourceRef="Event_HouseBuilt" targetRef="Task_SendInvitations"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Invitations_AttendeeList" sourceRef="Task_SendInvitations" targetRef="Task_CreateAttendeeList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AttendeeList_End" sourceRef="Task_CreateAttendeeList" targetRef="EndEvent_AttendeeListCreated"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
